title: Accept an Offer into Escrow
description: Follow the marketplace state transition when a seller accepts an offer.

content.prompt: What happens when a pending offer is accepted?
options: The accepted offer and listing enter escrow; remaining pending offers become outbid
All offers remain pending and the NFT is cancelled

solution: The accepted offer and listing enter escrow; remaining pending offers become outbid
hint: Accepted offers move the listing to ESCROWED and mark other pending offers OUTBID.
